title: Chikmagalur Coffee & Cloud Peaks
summary: A 3-day weekend escape across lush coffee plantations, rugged 4x4 trails to roaring waterfalls, highest peak trekking at Mullayanagiri (1,930m), and scenic ridge cruising on 125cc scooties.

basecamp.name: Tresca A Luxury Hotel
basecamp.location: RG Road, Vijayapura (Opp. Renukacharya Kalyana Mantapa)
basecamp.distanceFromStation: 850 meters (~2 mins by auto) from KSRTC Main Bus Stand
basecamp.arrivalStrategy: Arrive at 9:30 AM (2.5 hrs before check-in). Drop bags securely at the 24-hr cloakroom, freshen up in the lobby washroom, change into hill clothes, and head out immediately for breakfast and sightseeing without luggage.
basecamp.diningNote: Clean, modern rooms; no in-house kitchen. RG Road features premier dining within 2–5 min walk (Vishnu Delicacy, Town Caffee, Kailash Parbat, Hotel Matsya).

events.title: Arrival & Strategic Bag Drop at Tresca
events.desc: Arrive in Chikmagalur. Take a 2-min auto (850m) to Tresca A Luxury Hotel. Drop bags at 24-hr cloakroom, freshen up in lobby washroom, change into comfortable hill attire.
events.tip: Don't wait for standard 12:00 PM check-in; get out into the hills immediately without luggage!

events.title: South Indian Breakfast & Filter Kaapi
events.desc: Quick crispy dosas, idli-vada, and piping hot Chikmagalur filter coffee at Vishnu Delicacy or Town Caffee on RG Road.
events.tip: Fuel up well before the mountain drive.

events.title: Private Cab Pickup at Tresca
events.desc: Your pre-arranged private cab picks you up directly from hotel porch to handle hairpin ghat curves.
events.tip: Keep a light rain jacket/windcheater and cash handy.

events.title: Jhari (Buttermilk) Falls Off-Roading
events.desc: Cab drops at estate checkpost. Switch to local 4x4 open jeep (~₹800 per jeep) for a thrilling, muddy off-road descent through private coffee plantations to the roaring falls.
events.tip: Wear water-resistant footwear with good grip. Rocky surfaces can be slippery.

events.title: Countryside Malnad Lunch
events.desc: Relaxed lunch stop at Siri Cafe or a traditional Malnad eatery along the route.
events.tip: Try local Akki Roti or mild coconut vegetable curry.

events.title: Mullayanagiri Peak Climb (Highest in Karnataka)
events.desc: Afternoon timing is strategic: morning tourist rush has cleared. Climb the stone steps along the windy ridge to the 1,930m peak for panoramic views through drifting mist.
events.tip: Can get very windy and chilly; zip up your windcheaters.

events.title: Hirekolale Lake Golden Hour
events.desc: Descend from the hills and stop at Hirekolale Lake. Sit on the stone embankment watching the tranquil sunset reflecting across the mountain waters.
events.tip: Terrific spot for calm landscape photography.

events.title: Formal Check-in & Hot Shower
events.desc: Cab drops you back at Tresca. Collect bags, complete room check-in, unpack, and enjoy a long hot shower.
events.tip: Rest up your legs after the Mullayanagiri stone steps.

events.title: Dinner at The Estate Cafe or RG Road
events.desc: Enjoy a relaxed dinner at The Estate Cafe or stroll along RG Road for dinner at Kailash Parbat or Hotel Matsya.
events.tip: Early night sleep for Sunday morning scooty cruising!

events.title: Breakfast on RG Road
events.desc: Fresh morning breakfast on RG Road within walking distance from Tresca.
events.tip: Carry your physical driver's license for scooter rental.

events.title: Collect 125cc Scooters near KSRTC Stand
events.desc: Walk 500m towards KSRTC Bus Stand / Barlane Road to collect 125cc scooter (Happy Go Rentals or Royal Brothers).
events.tip: If 2 traveling: 1 scooty (125cc). If 3 traveling: rent 2 scooties to avoid hefty mountain traffic fines and ensure uphill power.

events.title: Baba Budangiri & Z-Point Ridge Trail
events.desc: Ride up the winding, scenic ghat roads through dense coffee estates to Baba Budangiri. Embark on the panoramic walk towards Z-Point (Kemmanagundi)—a narrow ridge trail with dramatic drops and lush valleys.
events.tip: Ride carefully around estate hairpin curves; honk on blind turns.

events.title: Estate-facing Lunch or Dhaba
events.desc: Lunch at an estate-facing cafe or local roadside dhaba along the descent.
events.tip: Try freshly made Neer Dosa or local Thali.

events.title: Coffee Museum & Plantation Cafe Pour-overs
events.desc: Ride back towards town along KM Road to visit the Coffee Museum (run by Coffee Board of India) to learn coffee harvesting, roasting, and bean classification. Stop by Cafe Agape or World of Coffee for artisanal pour-overs.
events.tip: Ask the barista about Malnad peaberry roast profiles.

events.title: Evening Town Cruising & Dinner
events.desc: Cruise through the evening breeze in town, grab dinner, and return to Tresca for a restful night.
events.tip: Fuel up the scooty if needle is low for Monday morning.

itinerary.title: Heritage, Coffee Shopping & Departure
itinerary.highlight: Belur / Aldur + Spice Shopping + Sleeper Bus

events.title: Breakfast & Packing Up
events.desc: Pack bags, have breakfast on RG Road, prepare daypacks for the final afternoon.
events.tip: Separate your bus travel clothes into a top pouch.

events.title: Check-out & Luggage Cloakroom Drop
events.desc: Check out of Tresca. Hand backpacks to front desk reception to hold safely in the cloakroom for the entire day.
events.tip: Reception is 24-hr staffed, so collection at 9 PM is seamless.

events.title: Choice of Final Day Route (By Scooty)
events.desc:
Choose between two outstanding experiences:
• Option A: 25 km ride to Belur to witness the 12th-century Hoysala Chennakeshava Temple.
• Option B: Scenic cruise down Aldur/Mudigere canopy road, stopping at Siri Coffee sculpture gardens.
events.tip: Belur has smooth, flat highway riding; Aldur has tree-shaded plantation twists.

events.title: Late Town Lunch
events.desc: Savor a leisurely late lunch at a top town restaurant.
events.tip: Stay hydrated after the afternoon ride.

events.title: Coffee & Malnad Spice Shopping on MG Road
events.desc:
• Fresh Ground Coffee: Freshly roasted Arabica/Robusta blends at Panduranga Coffee or Classic Coffee.
• Malnad Spices: Whole green cardamom, black pepper, and cinnamon bark.
• Local Snacks: Hot banana and jackfruit chips.
events.tip: Panduranga Coffee grinds your beans on the spot to match your home brewer.

events.title: Scooty Return & Deposit Settlement
events.desc: Return scooty to rental hub, collect security deposit, and hand back helmets.
events.tip: Inspect vehicle with the vendor to close the return slip cleanly.

events.title: Freshen Up at Tresca & Dinner
events.desc: Walk back to Tresca, collect bags from cloakroom, change into cozy bus clothes, and enjoy a sit-down dinner nearby.
events.tip: No rush—you are only 850m from the bus stand.

events.title: Board Overnight KSRTC AC Sleeper to BLR
events.desc: Take a 2-min auto (or easy 8-min walk) to KSRTC Bus Stand. Board 11:00 PM AC Sleeper bus back to Bengaluru. Arrives Tuesday ~05:00 AM.
events.tip: Set an alarm for 04:45 AM approaching Majestic/Yeshwantpur.

packingList.item: Valid Physical Driver's License (mandatory for scooty rental)
Cash ₹1,500–₹2,000 for Jhari Falls 4x4 Jeep & forest checkpost
Light Windcheater / Rain Jacket (windy at Mullayanagiri)
Comfortable trekking / walking shoes with good tread
Sunglasses & UV Sunscreen for scooty cruising
Offline Google Maps downloaded for Chikmagalur district
Tote bag / backpack space for fresh coffee powder & spices
